description: Search indexed repository documentation using semantic similarity (pro/dev tier) or BM25 keyword search (free tier). Returns relevant chunks with file paths for targeted reading. Index docs first with index_docs.

category.description: Filter results to a specific category (directory name, e.g., 'architecture', 'research')

match_count.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

project.description: Project namespace (e.g., 'my-project'). Scopes sessions and searches.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'how does authentication work', 'database schema')

name: search_docs
